{{Infobox Item |name = Skull sceptre (i) |image = [[File:Skull sceptre (i).png]] |release = [[18 May]] [[2017]] |update = Imbue Your Sceptre, Double Your Deaths, and get 3 for 2 on membership |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = No |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Wield, Invoke, Divine, Drop |wornoptions = Invoke, Divine |examine = An imbued magical Sceptre. |value = 1 |weight = 1.814 |id = 21276 |leagueRegion = Misthalin }} [[File:Skull sceptre (i) detail.png|left|160px]] The '''skull sceptre (i)''' is an imbued version of the [[skull sceptre]]. Like the regular skull sceptre, the imbued sceptre can be used to teleport to [[Barbarian Village]], and can autocast [[combat spells]] from the [[Arceuus spellbook]]. Unlike the regular skull sceptre, it can also autocast [[Crumble Undead]]. Unlike the regular skull sceptre, this sceptre does not break after depleting the teleport charges, and it can be recharged with [[bone fragments]] or [[skull sceptre#Creating_the_Sceptre|sceptre pieces]] as explained [[#Teleport mechanics|below]]. As it is one of the few teleport items available to [[free-to-play]], it is highly desired among those players. It can be obtained by players who use a [[Jagex Account]] or have set up the [[RuneScape Authenticator]] by showing a [[skull sceptre]] and a pair of [[Fancy boots|fancy]], [[Fancier boots|fancier]] or [[fighting boots]] (equipped, or in your inventory) to [[Solztun]] in the [[Stronghold of Security]]. If additional sceptres are created after imbuing a skull sceptre, any additional sceptres will start imbued. These additional sceptres can be stacked with the original in your bank. '''Warning: '''''Should players disable the Authenticator, the sceptre '''will''' revert to a regular [[skull sceptre]] when used on the next login after it is disabled. The chatbox message will read, "The Skull Sceptre suddenly loses its imbue due to the disabling of your authenticator."'' Additionally, if you disable the Authenticator and do not have a Jagex Account, '''you will need to make one''' in order to reimbue the sceptre, even if you reenable the authenticator. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = -1 |acrush = +7 |amagic = +10 |arange = 0 |dstab = +2 |dslash = +3 |dcrush = +1 |dmagic = +4 |drange = 0 |str = +3 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = weapon |speed = 5 |attackrange = 1 |combatstyle = Staff |image = [[File:Skull sceptre equipped.png|170px]] |altimage = [[File:Skull sceptre equipped female.png|170px]] }} {{CombatStyles|Staff|speed=5|attackrange=staff}} {{Autocasting|standard=yes|arceuus=yes|ancient=no|standard-comment=Can be used to autocast [[Crumble Undead]].}} ==Teleport mechanics== {{Map|x=3081|y=3421|mtype=pin|width=200|height=200|align=right}} The sceptre has two right-click options: * Invoke: The player will be teleported to the entrance of the [[Stronghold of Security]] in [[Barbarian Village]]. One charge will be consumed. * Divine: A dialogue box opens up that shows the number of remaining charges. The sceptre can hold a maximum of 10 charges by default. Once the player has completed the easy, medium, hard and elite [[Varrock Diary]], the sceptre can hold 14, 18, 22, and 26 charges respectively. At any time, players can use [[bone fragments]] or [[skull sceptre#Creating_the_Sceptre|sceptre pieces]] on the sceptre (which has to be in the inventory) to recharge it. Each fragment gives one charge. The amount of charges that a sceptre piece gives can be seen in the table below. It is the same as the amount of bone fragments that would be obtained by using a [[chisel]] on the sceptre piece. {| class="wikitable sortable align-center-1 align-left-2" style="text-align:right;" ! colspan="2" rowspan="2" |Item ! rowspan="2" |Default ! colspan="4" |Varrock Diary Completed |- !Easy!!Medium!!Hard!!Elite |- |{{plinkt|Left skull half}} |5||6||7||8||9 |- |{{plinkt|Bottom of sceptre}} |3||4||5||6||7 |- |{{plinkt|Top of sceptre}} |3||4||5||6||7 |- |{{plinkt|Right skull half}} |3||4||5||6||7 |} ==Creation== {{Recipe |members = no |ticks = |facilities = Solztun |notes = Use a [[Skull Sceptre]] on [[Solztun]] with [[Fancy boots|fancy]], [[Fighting boots|fighting]], or [[Fancier boots|fancier]] boots.
Must have an active [[RuneScape Authenticator]] or be using a [[Jagex Account]]. |mat1 = Skull sceptre |mat1cost = 0 |output1 = Skull sceptre (i) |output1cost = 0 }} ==Comparison between other magic weapons== {{Magic weapons comparison}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 30 June 2021 |update = Phosani's Nightmare |poll = A Night At The Theatre and Old School Content Poll 75: PvM |change = The skull sceptre (i) can now autocast [[Crumble Undead]]. }} {{Subject changes |date = 16 June 2021 |update = A Kingdom Divided |poll = A Kingdom Divided |change = The skull sceptre (i) can now autocast spells from the [[Arceuus spellbook]]. }} {{Subject changes |date = 28 April 2021 |update = Arceuus Spellbook Beta and A Kingdom Divided Preparation |change = The sceptre's magic attack bonus has been increased from +4 to +10. It was changed from a [[polestaff]] to a [[Weapons/Categories#Staff|staff]], but no spells could be autocast with it yet. }} {{Subject changes |date = 18 November 2020 |update = More Poll 73 Updates & Leagues Changes |poll = Old School Content Poll 73: The :Joy: of Polls |change = * Bone fragments can now be used to charge the sceptre. * The base number of charges you can hold on a completed Sceptre has been raised from 5 to 10. * Each completed tier of the Varrock Achievement Diary increases the number of max charges to 14, 18, 22, and 26 respectively. * Skull Sceptres are no longer destroyed they are dropped or killed and unprotected. * Multiple can be owned. * Multiple imbued Skull Sceptres share the same charges, but are only recharged with fragments, Sceptre pieces, or whole Skull Sceptres. * Unimbuing one imbued skull sceptre now unimbues them all, same rule for imbuing. * The "Destroy" option was replaced with a "Drop" option. }} {{Subject changes |date = 15 March 2018 |update = QoL, Deadman and the Falador Party Room |change = The "Teleport" option while equipped was replaced with "Divine" and "Invoke" options. }} {{Subject changes footer}} {{Magic weapons}} {{Stronghold of Security}} {{Teleportation items}} [[Category:Items with charges]]
